pages.text: Bram: $(italic)Thermal won't take river grit. It wants glass sand, washed.$()$(br2)Nella dredges it: Q26 is $(bold)96 Lake Sand$() off the shallows.$(br2)You wash it: Q30 is $(bold)64 Washed Silica$(). Two Lake Sand and a bucket of water make one on the bench, so 64 silica is $(bold)128 sand$() -- keep Nella's net out for the last two pulls. An $(item)Encased Fan$() blowing down through flowing water does the same job if you would rather watch it. Q30 pays another $(bold)64$() silica when you're done.
pages.title: Sand, twice

pages.text: The $(item)Thermal Machine Frame$() in this valley is built with $(item)Washed Silica$(). That is the entire gate -- no stage to chase, no unlock to find, just an ingredient somebody has to have made.$(br2)Q31 asks for $(bold)one$() frame and pays you back $(bold)two$() spares, a Redstone Furnace, 32 Energy Duct and a Stirling Dynamo.
pages.title: The gate

pages.text: Every Thermal machine is this same shape. Learn it once.

$(li)$(bold)Frame$() in the middle.$(li)$(bold)RF Coil$() directly beneath it.$(li)$(bold)Copper gear$() either side of the coil.$(li)Three pieces on the top and sides that say $(italic)which$() machine it is -- flint and a piston make a Pulverizer, bricks and redstone make a Furnace.$(br2)Sixteen machines, one recipe, three swapped parts.
pages.title: Reading the grid

pages.text: Q32 wants a $(item)Pulverizer$() built and $(bold)32 iron ore$() run through it. Ore doubles from that moment on, permanently, and Q32 hands you a Sawmill and 8 Redstone Servos for the trouble.$(br2)Power: one $(item)Stirling Dynamo$() from Q31, a second from Q32. They burn what the oven burns.
pages.title: First job
